**Chinese name:** 液化空气（中国）投资有限公司 (Yèhuà Kōngqì (Zhōngguó) Tóuzī Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A foreign (French-headquartered) industrial gas major with one of the largest confirmed manufacturing footprints of any multinational in China — reportedly close to 90 factories across 40+ Chinese cities and over 4,000 employees overall, with a dedicated electronics business (ultra-high-purity gases, chemical liquids, and related equipment for semiconductor, flat-panel-display, and photovoltaic customers) employing over 3,000 of them. Represented here at its Shanghai electronics-business base; its actual gas plants are distributed nationally, not concentrated at one site — a genuine case where a single map marker understates the real footprint.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Ultra-high-purity carrier gases, electronic specialty gases, and chemical liquids for semiconductor fabs, alongside related delivery equipment — a parallel supplier to Linde in the same specialty-gas chokepoint category.

## Capability Trajectory

- **2014**: On-site UHP nitrogen generator for SMIC Beijing Fab B2 (300mm, 28nm), EUR 18m, start early 2014
- **2022**: Wuhan plant, 52,000 Nm3/h N2 plus O2/Ar, for a flash memory leader; EUR ~70m
- **2027**: Four UHP N2 units for electronics customers in YRD/PRD, >100,000 Nm3/h, start late 2027-early 2028

## Manufacturing Sites in China

- **Air Liquide on-site N2 generator, SMIC Beijing Fab B2** (Beijing) — Ultra-high-purity nitrogen and bulk carrier gases for SMIC's 300mm 28nm fab
- **Air Liquide Wuhan electronics gas plant** (Wuhan) — 52,000 Nm3/h nitrogen plus oxygen and argon for a flash-memory maker (unnamed; YMTC is the Wuhan flash maker but not named)
